data.name: Khamsin
data.gender_notes: Khamsin is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Khamsin refers to a type of hot desert wind that brings change and renewal. The name Khamsin carries the meaning “Winds of change” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khamsin usually hope their child will grow to embody winds of change and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who brings positive change and renewal
data.etymology: Khamsin belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Winds of change.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khamsin total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: خمسي
in_arabic.meaning: اسماء الرياح الخماسين في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: الخمسي هو اسم يطلق على رياح الخماسين التي تهب في فصل الربيع في منطقة الشرق الأوسط، وتهب هذه الرياح لمدة 50 يومًا، وتعتبر من الظواهر الجوية المعروفة في المنطقة العربية.

in_urdu.name: خمسین
in_urdu.meaning: خمسین کا مطلب ہے وہ ہواؤں جو 50 دن تک چلتی ہیں
in_urdu.long_meaning: خمسین ایک عربی نام ہے جو ان ہواؤں سے ماخوذ ہے جو 50 دن تک چلتی ہیں، یہ ہوائیں وسطی مشرق میں واقع علاقوں میں ربیع کے موسم میں چلتی ہیں، اور ان کا تعلق اسلامی ثقافت اور تاریخ سے ہے۔

in_hindi.name: ख़म्सिन
in_hindi.meaning: ख़म्सिन का अर्थ है पचास दिनों तक चलने वाली हवाएं
in_hindi.long_meaning: ख़म्सिन एक अरबी नाम है जो मध्य पूर्व में रबी के मौसम में चलने वाली हवाओं से लिया गया है, जो पचास दिनों तक चलती हैं। यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति और इतिहास में महत्वपूर्ण है, और इसका अर्थ है 'पचास'।

in_pashto.name: خمسي
in_pashto.meaning: د خمسی په نوم یادیږی هغه بادونه چې د پنځوسو ورځو لپاره وهي
in_pashto.long_meaning: خمسی د عربي نوم څخه اخیستل شوی دی، دا د هغو بادونو په نوم یادیږی چې د پنځوسو ورځو لپاره په منځني ختیځ کې وهي، دا بادونه د بهار په موسم کې وهي او د افغانستان او پاکستان په فرهنگ او تاريخ کې مهم دي.

in_english.name: Khamsin
in_english.meaning: Winds that blow for 50 days in the Middle East
in_english.long_meaning: Khamsin is derived from the Arabic word for '50', referring to the 50-day period during which strong winds blow in the Middle East during the spring season. These winds are a well-known meteorological phenomenon in the region and hold cultural and historical significance in Islamic tradition.

data.cultural_impact: In Egyptian mythology and folklore, the Khamsin wind was feared for its destructive and chaotic nature, causing sandstorms that could devastate crops and barren landscapes. It was believed that this wind brought new beginnings and the end of the old, symbolizing transformation and change.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, Khamsin is recognized as a time of reflection and renewal, representing the spiritual journey towards growth and transformation. This name holds profound symbolism for Muslims as they reflect on their faith journey and seek to renew their commitment to Allah and His guidance. The wind itself serves as a reminder of the power of change and the need to embrace new beginnings, allowing us to become the best versions of ourselves spiritually.
